title: Re-apply removal of 'Made with Caffeine.ai' watermark from footer

requirements.text: In frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx, ensure the footer contains absolutely no 'Made with Caffeine.ai' branding, text, links, or attribution of any kind. The footer element itself may remain, but must be completely free of any Caffeine.ai references.
acceptanceCriteria: The site footer renders with no 'Made with Caffeine.ai' text visible
No anchor tag or link pointing to caffeine.ai or any related URL exists in the footer
The footer element itself remains present on all pages
No other Caffeine.ai branding appears anywhere in the footer HTML

constraints: Do not remove the footer element itself — only strip the Caffeine.ai attribution content
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
nonGoals: Changing any other footer content or styling
Altering the blue/green 'Campus Connect' brand name styling
